opening.argument: The presentation offers paid mining participation by tying a Bitcoin payment and larger contract amounts to profits. The speaker describes a mining-share contract costing 500, 1000, or 2000, alongside a $99 payment, and says that after payment the participant will receive profits. It further presents continued purchasing as necessary to grow and introduces referrals as part of the income structure. Although the speaker attributes United States unavailability to tax rules, the presentation minimizes that restriction by saying contract profits can still be generated. These are concrete promises of paid participation and returns, while the records do not establish that mining occurred, that returns were delivered, or that anyone suffered a loss.
